牡羊.plain: With Aries rising, the first thing people see in you is someone direct, energetic, and quick to act. In a new setting you often skip the warm-up: you speak first, move first, and things get going because of you. That drive is your calling card. It makes you seem lively, easy to be around, and straightforward. Where you can get stuck: you move so fast that others haven't caught up and you grow impatient, or your first reaction comes on strong and you only notice your tone was harsh after the words are out. Try taking one extra breath before you speak, and ask "What do you think?" Your drive stays, and people will be more willing to go with you. When you're tired, give yourself something that makes you sweat. It's better than bottling it up.

faq.q: How are people with Aries rising usually seen at first meeting?
faq.a: Mostly as frank, energetic, and not given to beating around the bush. The upside is that you break the ice easily and people know what you're thinking. The thing to watch is that your first sentence doesn't come too fast. Let the other person finish half a sentence first, and the impression shifts from "pushy" to "someone who takes responsibility."

faq.q: What work rhythm suits Aries rising?
faq.a: A sprinter's rhythm usually suits you best: tasks with a clear goal where you can see results quickly. You can handle long projects too. Just cut them into small stages and reward yourself a little after each one, and you're less likely to lose patience halfway.

金牛.plain: With Taurus rising, your first impression is steady, unhurried, and with a sense of quality. You don't rush your words or fidget, and people naturally relax around you. You tend to observe first, and only open up slowly once you're sure a place is safe and a person is reliable. That steadiness is attractive, especially when everyone else is panicking and you're the one who calms the room. Where you can get stuck: when change comes too fast, you resist by instinct, even showing disagreement by simply not moving. Try saying "I need some time to think" out loud, so others know you aren't refusing, just keeping your own pace. Eating well, sleeping well, and having things around you that feel good are the fastest ways for you to recover.

faq.q: Why is Taurus rising often called a slow burner?
faq.a: Because you like to confirm that you feel safe before you hand over trust. That isn't coldness; it's how you filter. If you want new friends to get to know you sooner, invite them to a meal or to do a small task together. Spending real time in place of small talk will feel more comfortable to you.

faq.q: What should Taurus rising do when plans change suddenly?
faq.a: Don't rush to say yes or no. Give yourself a few minutes and write down what the change would affect, and see which parts really touch what you care about. Often the real impact is smaller than your first feeling, and you can adjust more calmly.

雙子.plain: With Gemini rising, people often find you quick, full of topics, and easy to talk to. When you arrive somewhere, your eyes and ears take in information at once, you pick up on what others say quickly, and you can lighten the mood. You often look younger than your age, with curiosity written on your face. Where you can get stuck: your attention spreads too thin. You open several topics and tasks at once and finish each only halfway, or you speak so smoothly that others can't tell what you really think. Set aside a regular time to wrap up, go over what you started today, and pick one or two things to finish. Now and then, slow your speech and explain one idea fully, and your intelligence will be easier to see.

faq.q: What misunderstandings do people with Gemini rising run into?
faq.a: Sometimes you're seen as someone whose enthusiasm fades in three minutes, or as not serious enough. In fact you just absorb quickly and shift quickly. With important people or matters, say how committed you are, for example by telling them how far you'll follow through, and there will be far fewer misunderstandings.

faq.q: How can Gemini rising feel less tired?
faq.a: Your tiredness often comes from a mind that won't stop. Before bed, write your to-dos and thoughts on paper, which is like closing some browser tabs. During the day, plan a short stretch with no messages and no phone scrolling so your head can truly rest.

巨蟹.plain: With Cancer rising, you come across as gentle, warm, and caring. You read the room well. If someone's expression is off, you feel it first, and you're often the one quietly handing over water and remembering who doesn't eat spicy food. When you first meet people you may hold back a little, as if protecting yourself with a shell, but once you're close you are deeply nostalgic and fiercely protective. Where you can get stuck: your feelings show on your face but you don't always say them, so others have to guess, or you want to care for everyone so much that you forget to ask whether you're tired. Practice naming your feeling in one sentence, such as "I'm a bit down today, it's not about you." Having a home or a corner where you can relax matters a lot to you.

faq.q: Why do people with Cancer rising seem easily hurt?
faq.a: Because you're sensitive to the atmosphere, an offhand remark from someone may stay with you for days. That's attentiveness, not fragility. Try a habit: when a comment bothers you, ask what the person meant instead of quietly filling in the whole story yourself.

faq.q: What are the strengths of Cancer rising at work?
faq.a: People trust you easily, and on a team you're often the one who holds everyone together. Looking after clients, guiding newcomers, and handling communication that needs empathy are all strengths. Be careful not to take all the emotional labor onto yourself; hand off what should be shared.

獅子.plain: With Leo rising, you have presence the moment you walk in. It isn't necessarily that you try to grab the spotlight; your expression, bearing, and way of speaking are simply more generous, so people notice you easily. Your first impression is warm, confident, and a little dramatic, and you're happy to liven up a room. Where you can get stuck: you care whether others see the effort you put in, and being overlooked hurts more than it shows. Sometimes, for the sake of pride, you also hold on and don't say you need help. Say honestly that you want to be recognized; there's no shame in that. When you sincerely applaud others and share the stage, your own light actually shines brighter.

faq.q: Are all Leo risings outgoing?
faq.a: Not necessarily. Some Leo risings need a lot of time alone in private, and only put on that generous manner once they step in front of people. The brightness outside and the rhythm inside can differ. When you're tired, step off the stage and rest; you don't have to shine all the time.

faq.q: How should Leo rising handle criticism?
faq.a: First separate "this was not done well" from "I am not good." You easily take comments as a rejection of your whole self, so take a deep breath after listening, pick one or two suggestions that are truly useful to act on, and let the rest go. You'll recover faster than you expect.

處女.plain: With Virgo rising, people see you as attentive, neat, and organized. When you enter a space, you quickly notice what's messy and what could be better, and you often fix small problems before anyone else notices. Your first impression may be quiet and polite, but after a while people find you very reliable, and what's entrusted to you rarely goes wrong. Where you can get stuck: you're too hard on yourself and replay a small flaw over and over, or you mean well in pointing something out but it sounds like nitpicking. Start with what you appreciate, then say what you'd like changed, and people will take it in more easily. Also remember to give your own performance a passing grade; you don't need a perfect score every time before you let yourself rest.

faq.q: Why do people with Virgo rising often feel tense?
faq.a: Because your radar is always on, scanning for what could still be improved. That focus is useful, but it wears you out. Each day, set a line for yourself: "this much is enough." When time's up, stop, and give your body and mind room to breathe.

faq.q: What should Virgo rising watch for in love?
faq.a: You often show love by doing things: tidying up for your partner, reminding them, making arrangements. They may not read these as affection, and sometimes feel managed. Now and then, simply tell them you care. It will land more easily than ten more things done.

天秤.plain: With Libra rising, your first impression is elegant, friendly, and tactful. You consider everyone's feelings when you speak, you often have your own sense of beauty in how you dress and treat people, and many enjoy your company. You're good at finding balance between different positions, and in a group you're often the one who keeps the mood from stiffening. Where you can get stuck: you want everyone to be satisfied so much that you can't say what you really want, and when a decision is needed you may waver for a long time. First answer in your head, "If I only considered myself, which would I choose?" and then consider others. You're entitled to preferences. Saying them gently won't hurt your good relationships; it makes people trust you more.

faq.q: Why is it hard for Libra rising to make decisions?
faq.a: You tend to see both sides at once and take in the pros and cons of every option, which makes letting go of one harder. Set yourself a deadline. When time is up, pick the one that feels smoother right now, and adjust later. Once you decide, your sense of balance comes back.

faq.q: What does a Libra rising do in a conflict?
faq.a: Your first reaction may be to give in so things stay peaceful. That works in the short run, but over time it can build up resentment. Try voicing a little real disagreement in a friendly tone, such as "I see what you mean, but I have another thought." The conflict is often easier to settle that way.

天蠍.plain: With Scorpio rising, you come across as a bit deep and hard to read. You like to size people up first, then decide how much of yourself to show, and your eyes often say more than your words. Many people find you mysterious and magnetic, while some find you hard to approach at first. Once people know you, they see how loyal you are. When you commit, you give yourself fully, and you can stay beside someone through very hard times. Where you can get stuck is guardedness: keeping everything inside and working through it alone, or finding it hard to open up again once you feel betrayed. Pick one or two people you truly trust and practice saying what matters to you, bit by bit. Your depth is a gift, and you don't have to carry it alone.

faq.q: Why don't Scorpio risings talk much about themselves?
faq.a: For you, sharing is a form of trust, and trust takes time to build. You aren't keeping your distance on purpose. You first need to know the other person can handle it. To get closer, start with one small thing, see how they respond, then decide on the next step.

faq.q: How can a Scorpio rising let go of a knot inside?
faq.a: You remember things deeply, the good and the bad. Rather than forcing yourself to let go right away, write the matter down, and keep writing until you feel you've said it all. Once you see the whole picture, it's easier to decide whether to keep carrying it.

射手.plain: With Sagittarius rising, you come across as cheerful, frank, and easy to talk to. You laugh easily, and conversation jumps to faraway places: travel, new ideas, thoughts on life. Talking with you makes the world feel bigger. You don't like being tied down, and you're often the first to say "Sure, let's try it" when a new chance appears. Where you can get stuck is speaking too bluntly, so that what feels honest to you stings someone else, or saying yes too fast, then overbooking yourself and having to cancel. Check your calendar before agreeing and leave some breathing room. Before saying something harsh, ask yourself whether the person needs the truth right now or just your company. Your optimism is contagious, so let it carry people forward.

faq.q: Why do Sagittarius risings often want to go out and explore?
faq.a: You recharge on new stimulation, and staying in the same setting too long feels stuffy. You don't need to actually go abroad. Taking a different route, joining a new class, or meeting people from other circles can all refresh you and bring back new ideas.

faq.q: How can a Sagittarius rising balance freedom and commitment?
faq.a: See a commitment as a direction you chose, not a cage. Agree up front on what you'll see through to the end and where you'll keep some flexibility. The other person knows where the lines are, and you're less likely to feel tied down.

摩羯.plain: With Capricorn rising, others see you as mature, steady, and dependable. You may have been called "sensible" since childhood. You say little when you first meet, but your words carry weight. You tend to take on responsibility first, work with a plan, and are willing to build things up slowly over a long time. Many people think of you when someone needs to make a decision. Where you can get stuck is putting yourself in the grown-up role too early and forgetting to relax and play, or looking so serious that people hesitate to come close. Allow yourself to be less efficient now and then, and leave some time for joy with no purpose. Time is on your side. Many things get easier the longer you do them, and life tends to feel lighter as you go.

faq.q: Why do Capricorn risings seem more serious?
faq.a: Your expression and posture often say "I'm handling something carefully," so people feel they can't joke with you. Once they know you, you actually have a dry sense of humor. Making a small joke first or greeting people yourself will close the distance.

faq.q: What can a Capricorn rising do when stressed?
faq.a: You're used to holding up on your own and rarely say even when you're tired. Break a big goal into one small step you can finish this week, and when it's done, truly rest. Find someone you can vent to as well. Talking out your stress doesn't mean you aren't strong.

水瓶.plain: With Aquarius rising, you come across as a bit unusual and full of your own ideas. You often see things from a different angle than others, and you speak directly and rationally, so people find you calm and not one to follow the crowd. You're friendly to people, and your circle of friends may be quite varied, but you need to keep your own space, and clingy relationships make you want to step back. Where you can get stuck is that when emotions come, you analyze first, and others feel distance from you, or you insist on independence so much that you're shy to ask for help. Try naming a feeling before you reason, such as "I actually care about this a bit." What sets you apart is a big reason people like you.

faq.q: Why are Aquarius risings often said to seem distant?
faq.a: You tend to observe and think first, and your feelings don't show much on your face, so others assume you don't care. In fact you value your friends, but you express it in a more rational way. Now and then, check in with a line or share something small, and your warmth comes through.

faq.q: What kind of team suits an Aquarius rising?
faq.a: You do your best where you can offer ideas freely and aren't bound by too many rules. If you're in a more traditional place, find one or two people willing to hear your new ideas and start on a small scale. It's easier for everyone to accept change that way.

雙魚.plain: With Pisces rising, you come across as soft, gentle, and a little dreamy. You pick up on other people's feelings easily, and often know someone is in a bad mood that day without them saying a word. Many people feel understood around you and are willing to confide in you. You also respond strongly to beauty, music, and stories, and inspiration often arrives when you least expect it. Where you can get stuck is that your boundaries are a bit blurry, so other people's emotions slip into you and you only notice how tired you are once you're home, or you feel too shy to refuse and agree to things you don't want to do. After seeing people, give yourself some quiet time and hand other people's moods back to them. Learning to say "Not this time" will help your gentleness last.

faq.q: Why do Pisces risings tire easily?
faq.a: You're like a sponge, taking in the emotions around you. After a long time in a crowd, you use up more energy than most people. Set aside time alone, with music or a walk, to slowly let go of what you've absorbed, then return to people.

faq.q: What should a Pisces rising watch for at work?
faq.a: Your intuition and empathy are strong, and you suit work that calls for creativity or caring for people. What to watch is deadlines and details, since getting absorbed in feelings can make you lose track of time. Use reminders or lists to keep track of progress, so your inspiration can land well.

aspects.太陽-月亮|合: With the Sun conjunct the Moon, what you want to do and what you feel inside are often on the same line, so decisions wear you down less. Watch for seeing things only from your own point of view, and now and then deliberately listen to different voices.
aspects.太陽-月亮|六合: With the Sun sextile the Moon, there's a smooth little path between reason and emotion. You usually know what you want and can look after your mood. If you actively use it, this harmony gives your life a lot of room.
aspects.太陽-月亮|刑: With the Sun square the Moon, what you want and what you need often pull against each other, such as wanting to push your career while your heart wants company. This tension pushes you to know yourself better. Making room for both in your life works better than forcing yourself to choose one.
aspects.太陽-月亮|拱: With the Sun trine the Moon, your inside and outside are more in line, your emotions don't hold you back much, and you come across as at ease and easy to get along with. When things go smoothly, it's easy to settle into the status quo, so now and then set yourself a goal that stretches you a little.
aspects.太陽-月亮|沖: With the Sun opposite the Moon, it's like two people live inside you, one heading out and one wanting to go home. This pull makes you good at seeing both positions. Practicing taking turns caring for each side is your way of balancing.
aspects.太陽-水星|合: With the Sun conjunct Mercury, your thoughts and your sense of self are very close, and your speech often carries your personality and stance, so you express yourself persuasively. Where you can get stuck is trusting your own judgment too much, so in discussions, first ask "What do you think?"
aspects.太陽-水星|六合: In a natal chart, Mercury is at most about 28 degrees from the Sun, so the two can't form a sextile. If a compatibility reading shows one person's Sun sextile the other's Mercury, it means the two of you chat easily and your ideas connect readily.
aspects.太陽-水星|刑: Mercury stays very close to the Sun, so the two can't form a square in a natal chart. If a compatibility reading shows your Sun square the other person's Mercury, it means you may easily talk past each other when communicating, so first confirm you're speaking about the same thing.
aspects.太陽-水星|拱: In a natal chart the Sun and Mercury are never more than about 28 degrees apart, so they can't form a trine. In a compatibility reading, if one person's Sun trines the other's Mercury, you tend to take in what the other says easily, which is great for talking through plans together.
aspects.太陽-水星|沖: The Sun and Mercury can't be in opposition in a natal chart, because Mercury always stays near the Sun. If a Sun-opposite-Mercury shows up in a compatibility reading, the two of you see things from opposite angles, which can fill in what the other hasn't thought of.
aspects.太陽-金星|合: With Sun conjunct Venus, your personality carries gentleness and a sense of beauty. People like you easily, and you know how to enjoy life. Watch for this: when you want to be liked too much, you may find it hard to say no. Guard your boundaries yourself.
aspects.太陽-金星|六合: Venus is at most about 47 degrees from the Sun, so the two can't form a sextile in a natal chart. If one person's Sun sextiles the other's Venus in a compatibility reading, it points to an easy time together, with each appreciating the other's good qualities.
aspects.太陽-金星|刑: The Sun and Venus aren't far enough apart to form a square in a natal chart. If you see Sun square Venus in a compatibility reading, the two of you may differ on taste or on how to spend money. Talking it through can actually build better understanding.
aspects.太陽-金星|拱: Because Venus always stays near the Sun, a natal chart can't have Sun trine Venus. When this aspect appears in a compatibility reading, it is often a pairing with instant good feeling and effortless time together. Remember to tend to it together, too.
aspects.太陽-金星|沖: The Sun and Venus can't be in opposition in a natal chart. If one person's Sun opposes the other's Venus in a compatibility reading, the attraction is strong but the expectations differ. Talk more about the kind of relationship each of you wants, and things will go more smoothly.
aspects.太陽-火星|合: With Sun conjunct Mars, you have strong drive and ambition, act on what comes to mind, and can lead the charge. When you have a lot of energy, give it an outlet, such as exercise or a challenging task, so it doesn't turn into impatience.
aspects.太陽-火星|六合: With Sun sextile Mars, you can put in effort naturally when it's needed, and your courage and confidence work well together. When an opportunity comes, don't just wait for others to push you. Step forward yourself, and the result is often better than expected.
aspects.太陽-火星|刑: With Sun square Mars, there's an inner push that often makes you eager to prove yourself, and you can clash head-on with people. Use that drive to compete with who you were yesterday, and it becomes a powerful motivator.
aspects.太陽-火星|拱: With Sun trine Mars, you work with drive but without recklessness, and your stamina and will tend to last longer. This ease is well suited to practicing a skill that needs long-term commitment, and you'll slowly see results.
aspects.太陽-火星|沖: With Sun opposite Mars, you often meet challenges through other people, as if your competitive side is being stirred up. This tension can make you stronger. The key is telling which battles are worth fighting and which you can let go with a smile.
aspects.月亮-水星|合: With Moon conjunct Mercury, feeling and thinking are tied together. You speak with warmth and are good at putting feelings into words. When your emotions swing, your thoughts run along with them, so write things down first, then decide how to reply.
aspects.月亮-水星|六合: With Moon sextile Mercury, you're good at putting what you feel into words others understand, which suits listening and communicating. Use this ability to speak up for yourself, not only for others.
aspects.月亮-水星|刑: With Moon square Mercury, your head says one thing while your heart feels another, and sometimes overthinking makes you more anxious. Practice acknowledging the feeling first, then analyzing it, and your mind and heart will slowly get in tune.
aspects.月亮-水星|拱: With Moon trine Mercury, your mind is sensitive and clear. You have a good memory, are attuned to people's tone, and learn at your own pace. It suits writing, teaching, or anything that needs clear explanation.
aspects.月亮-水星|沖: With Moon opposite Mercury, reason and emotion often stand on opposite sides, and when communicating you may feel the other person doesn't understand you. Say "What I'm feeling right now is…" first, then "What I think is…", and there will be far fewer misunderstandings.
aspects.月亮-金星|合: With Moon conjunct Venus, you value comfortable, gentle relationships, naturally look after the atmosphere, and help people relax. Watch for swallowing hurt because you fear conflict. It's okay to say it out loud now and then.
aspects.月亮-金星|六合: With Moon sextile Venus, you're warm toward others and good at arranging small pleasures for yourself. This gentleness is the source of your popularity. Invite people to a meal or a chat, and relationships will grow closer.
aspects.月亮-金星|刑: With Moon square Venus, you're often pulled between wanting to be cared for and wanting to be admired, and in love you may feel that what the other gives isn't what you want. Work out what you truly need first, then ask for it clearly.
aspects.月亮-金星|拱: With Moon trine Venus, you express feelings naturally and warmly, appreciate beautiful things, and people around you often feel at ease with you. Remember to keep a little of that gentleness for yourself.
aspects.月亮-金星|沖: With Moon opposite Venus, your inner needs and outer preferences often don't match, for example saying "anything is fine" while actually caring a lot. Face both sides honestly, and you'll see more clearly what kind of person and life to choose.
aspects.月亮-火星|合: With Moon conjunct Mars, emotions come and go quickly, you want to act the moment you feel something, and you have the courage to protect others. When tired or annoyed you can get hasty, so move your body first, then deal with the mood.
aspects.月亮-火星|六合: With Moon sextile Mars, you can turn emotion into drive and go after what you care about. You're also more willing to speak up about things that bother you. Used well, this directness puts people at ease.
aspects.月亮-火星|刑: With Moon square Mars, when you feel uneasy you want to strike back or cover your feelings with busyness. This heat is your protection. Practice pausing for three seconds and naming the feeling, and impulse turns into clear action.
aspects.月亮-火星|拱: With Moon trine Mars, when your emotions are steady your drive is especially good, and you're active in caring for family and friends. Exercise or hands-on work suits you for sorting out your mood. The more you move, the more energized you feel.
aspects.月亮-火星|沖: With Moon opposite Mars, you need security, yet often meet people or situations that push you to act, and your emotions are easily lit. This tension teaches you to protect yourself and to tell which things are worth getting angry about.
aspects.水星-金星|合: With Mercury conjunct Venus, you speak with taste and warmth, give compliments well, and suit writing, design, or any communication that needs a sense of beauty. Watch for making things sound nice without getting the main point across.
aspects.水星-金星|六合: With Mercury sextile Venus, you express yourself gently and in an orderly way, and in negotiation or mediation you find wording both sides can accept. This ability suits cooperation and relationships, large and small.
aspects.水星-金星|刑: Mercury and Venus are at most about 76 degrees apart in a natal chart, so they can't form a square. If one person's Mercury squares the other's Venus in a compatibility reading, the way of speaking may differ from the gentleness the other expects. Slowing your tone is enough.
aspects.水星-金星|拱: Mercury trine Venus can't appear in a natal chart, because both orbit close to the Sun. If this aspect shows up in a compatibility reading, the two of you chat easily, even your bickering has some sweetness, and it makes a good base for communication.
aspects.水星-金星|沖: Mercury and Venus can't be in opposition in a natal chart. If it appears in a compatibility reading, one of you values reason and the other feeling. Before speaking, think about what the other cares about, and things will go much more smoothly.
aspects.水星-火星|合: With Mercury conjunct Mars, your mind moves fast, you speak directly and forcefully, and you're strong in debate and quick reactions. When rushed, your words can come out too harsh, so pause before sending important messages.
aspects.水星-火星|六合: With Mercury sextile Mars, ideas quickly become action, you work efficiently, and you can explain a plan so that people want to follow. Use it where problems need solving, and you'll feel a real sense of achievement.
aspects.水星-火星|刑: With Mercury square Mars, discussion easily turns into argument, and your thoughts run faster than your mouth. This sharpness is actually great for spotting problems and loopholes. Aim it at the issue, not at the person.
aspects.水星-火星|拱: With Mercury trine Mars, thinking and action work well together, you pick up new things quickly, and you get to the point when you speak. It suits work that needs fast judgment and execution, and you get sharper with practice.
aspects.水星-火星|沖: With Mercury opposite Mars, you get especially heated when opinions differ, feeling you must win the argument. This energy can become strong persuasiveness. Hear the other person out first, then state your position clearly once.
aspects.金星-火星|合: With Venus conjunct Mars, your attractiveness and passion are obvious, you approach what you like, and you have creative drive. You can get carried away, so give relationships and plans some time to observe before going all in.
aspects.金星-火星|六合: With Venus sextile Mars, liking and action work together well. You show affection naturally without awkwardness and pursue what you want with a sense of measure. This energy suits love and creative work.
aspects.金星-火星|刑: With Venus square Mars, you want closeness and freedom at once, and in love there's often a tension of loving and being impatient. Use that heat to express your real needs, and the relationship gets more spark and more honesty.
aspects.金星-火星|拱: With Venus trine Mars, your charm shows naturally, you're warm yet gentle with people, and love and friendships tend to go smoothly. When things go well, don't forget to tend them, so the warmth lasts.
aspects.金星-火星|沖: With Venus opposite Mars, you're often drawn to people very different from you, and being together brings both sparks and friction. Treat differences as learning, and practice finding a rhythm between getting close and keeping space.

node.牡羊: With the North Node in Aries, what you're practicing this lifetime is making decisions for yourself. You're used to considering others and going along with everyone. Now the direction is to ask first what you want and take the first step boldly, without waiting for everyone to agree.
node.金牛: With the North Node in Taurus, what you're practicing this lifetime is settling down and building your own sense of security. Rather than chasing intense emotions and change, try taking good care of your body and tending your daily life, slowly building up what truly belongs to you.
node.雙子: The North Node in Gemini points toward staying curious and asking and listening more. You may be used to trusting the big truths in your own head. Now you can loosen your certainty a little, talk with the people around you, and learn something new from small things.
node.巨蟹: The North Node in Cancer means this life is about letting yourself be cared for, and truly caring for others. Instead of chasing only achievement and outer status, make room for home, feelings, and your inner world, and allow yourself to be soft.
node.獅子: The North Node in Leo points toward stepping forward and expressing yourself. You're used to blending into the group and thinking of everyone else. Now you can do more of what makes you happy and let people see your creativity and passion.
node.處女: The North Node in Virgo means this life is about grounding your dreams. You're very sensitive and can easily drift with your moods and imagination. The direction now is to build routines, do one thing well, and gather confidence from small, concrete steps.
node.天秤: The North Node in Libra is about cooperation and listening. You're used to handling everything on your own. Now you can learn to treat others as partners, adjust together within a relationship, and find that walking side by side is good too.
node.天蠍: The North Node in Scorpio means this life is about going deeper and letting go. Rather than clinging to what's familiar and comfortable, try building deeper trust with others. When you're willing to let old things end, new possibilities can come in.
node.射手: The North Node in Sagittarius points toward looking farther and trusting a bigger meaning. You're good at gathering information and analyzing details. Now you can connect them into your own beliefs and step beyond what's familiar to see the world.
node.摩羯: The North Node in Capricorn means this life is about taking responsibility for your own path and stepping out of the shelter of home. Set long-term goals and build your place step by step. You may find you can carry more than you thought.
node.水瓶: The North Node in Aquarius is about placing yourself within a larger group. You have a light of your own. The direction now is to work with like-minded people and put your talents toward goals you share with others.
node.雙魚: The North Node in Pisces means this life is about trust and relaxing. You're analytical and good at getting things done. Now you can learn to loosen control, trust your intuition, and leave time for quiet, art, and the spirit.

planets.太陽: The Sun stands for your core: who you want to become, and what makes you feel you're shining. When people ask "what's your sign," they're asking about the Sun.
planets.月亮: The Moon stands for your emotions and sense of security: what you need when you're tired and what makes you feel cared for. It also reflects how you are in private and when you relax.
planets.水星: Mercury governs thinking and communication. It shows how you learn, how you speak, and how you organize information. To find the way of expressing yourself that comes easiest, look at Mercury.
planets.金星: Venus stands for what you like, how you love, and your sense of beauty and values. Attraction in relationships and the way you enjoy life are both tied to Venus.
planets.火星: Mars is your drive and energy. It shows how you go after things, how you face conflict, and what you're like when angry. It also shows where you have the most get-up-and-go.
planets.木星: Jupiter stands for growth and opportunity. It shows where you expand easily and what you're especially optimistic about. It points to where it's worth being bold, and also reminds you not to overdo it.
planets.土星: Saturn stands for responsibility, discipline, and lessons that take time. Where it lands is often a place that feels hard at first but grows steadier the more you practice.
planets.天王星: Uranus stands for change and breakthroughs. It shows where you want to break routine and seek freedom. It moves very slowly, so people born in the same era often have similar placements.
planets.海王星: Neptune governs imagination, inspiration, and ideals. It shows where you're easily moved and also where you may see less clearly. It reminds you to stay clear-headed between romance and reality.
planets.冥王星: Pluto stands for deep transformation. It shows where you go through a process of letting go and being reborn. Its influence is slow and deep, and often tied to the shared experience of a generation.

intro: A birth chart is a map of the sky as seen from your birthplace at the moment you were born. It records which sign and house the Sun, Moon, and other planets were in, and what angles they formed with each other. The Sun sign shows your core direction, the "what's your sign" answer. The Moon sign shows your emotions and sense of security, how you are in private, when tired, and when you need care. The rising sign shows the first impression you give and how you approach new environments. The Sun only needs a birth date, and the Moon is usually fairly certain too. The rising sign and houses are different: they change sign about every two hours on average, so they need a fairly reliable birth time and place. Reading all three together gives a much fuller picture than the Sun sign alone.

faq.q: What is a rising sign?
faq.a: Your rising sign is the sign that was rising on the eastern horizon at the moment you were born. It represents the first impression you give and how you react to new environments. It also decides where the twelve houses begin, so it's an important starting point for reading a chart.

faq.q: What if I'm not sure of my birth time?
faq.a: You can start by looking only at which signs the planets are in and the aspects between them, and set aside the rising sign and houses, since being off by an hour or two can change the rising sign. If the Moon changed signs that day, there may be two possibilities too. Once you ask family or find the birth certificate, just add the time.

faq.q: Why do I need a birth place?
faq.a: At the same moment, the sky looks different in Taipei and London. The rising sign, Midheaven, and houses are all calculated from the latitude and longitude of the birthplace. The place also involves the local time zone and daylight saving time, so you need to choose a city; a time zone alone isn't enough.

faq.q: What's the difference between house systems? How do Placidus and whole sign differ?
faq.a: A house system is a way of dividing the sky into twelve houses. Placidus divides by time, so houses vary in size. Whole sign makes each sign exactly one house, which is easier to read. The planets' signs are the same in both; the difference is that some planets fall into different houses. Try both and pick the one that resonates when you read it.

faq.q: What is retrograde?
faq.a: Retrograde is when a planet appears to move backward as seen from Earth. A retrograde planet in a birth chart usually means that in that area you tend to think inward and review things. You may start more slowly but think more deeply, and that isn't a bad thing.

faq.q: What does the Moon sign show?
faq.a: The Moon sign shows your emotional reactions and where your sense of security comes from: how you want to be comforted when you're down, and what kind of setting lets you relax. Many people feel the Sun sign description doesn't quite fit them, and only feel understood after reading their Moon sign.

faq.q: How is a birth chart different from a horoscope?
faq.a: A typical horoscope uses only the Sun sign and writes for everyone of that sign as one group. A birth chart is drawn from your own birth date, time, and place, and looks at all ten planets, the houses, and the aspects. It's a map that belongs to you alone.

faq.q: How is a birth chart different from Zi Wei Dou Shu and BaZi (Four Pillars)?
faq.a: A birth chart is Western astrology, based on the planets' actual positions in the sky at birth. Zi Wei Dou Shu and BaZi are Chinese systems that use the lunar calendar or the stem-branch calendar, and they calculate time differently. The three take different angles, so you can treat them as ways of getting to know yourself from different directions.

太陽|牡羊.title: Someone who feels it once they get moving
太陽|牡羊.plain: With your Sun in Aries, your energy comes from the act of beginning. New plans and new challenges make you feel most alive. You tend to act first and think later, and when you hit a snag you're more willing to charge straight through. This courage often makes you the first to raise a hand, though your enthusiasm comes fast and can fade fast. Save a little strength for finishing, so the fire you start becomes real work.
太陽|牡羊.love: When you like someone, it shows. You're not good at hinting. If the other person warms up slowly, you may be impatient for an answer. Try slowing the pace of "are we together or not" by half a beat, so they have a chance to move toward you too.
太陽|牡羊.work: You suit roles that need someone to open the way, make the call, and race the clock. You shine in the early stage of a new project and can lose patience in the routine stage, so pair up with someone who's good at finishing.
太陽|牡羊.watch: Going too fast is your most common snag: words out before you think, decisions made before you realize you skipped a question. For important things, count to ten before replying.

太陽|金牛.title: The steady, grounded builder
太陽|金牛.plain: "Real" may be the word that speaks to you most. With your Sun in Taurus, things you can see, touch, and use for a long time give you peace of mind. You don't rush, but once you've decided, you can hold on and rarely quit halfway. Small pleasures in life, like a good meal or a comfortable bed, aren't luxuries for you but a way to recharge. You can trust your own pace, though now and then you'll need to allow plans to change.
太陽|金牛.love: You show you care through actions: remembering what someone likes to eat, staying by their side for the long haul. You value steadiness more than sweet words. Relationships that change too much unsettle you, so say out loud what kind of security you need.
太陽|金牛.work: Work where you build patiently and results add up suits you, like managing resources, guarding quality, or tending long-term clients. Your reliability gets noticed. Remember to speak up and negotiate for what you're worth.
太陽|金牛.watch: Watch for resistance to change: staying in something that already feels bad because it's familiar. Now and then, ask yourself whether this is stability or just being afraid to move.

太陽|雙子.title: A conversation partner led by curiosity
太陽|雙子.plain: New information, new friends, new topics: they all make your eyes light up. With the Sun in Gemini, you feel alive by knowing more. Your mind moves fast, you can see several angles on one thing, and in conversation you're often the one who lifts the mood. But with so many interests, you may dabble in everything. Pick one or two things you truly care about and dig deep, so your flexibility becomes your specialty rather than a reason to scatter.
太陽|雙子.love: Being able to talk matters more to you than almost anything. You need someone who can wander through any topic with you and catch your jokes. If a relationship shrinks down to routine, you'll feel stifled, so look for new things to do together.
太陽|雙子.work: Communication, writing, teaching, sales, and work that juggles several threads at once suit you. You learn quickly. Build one deeper skill so people remember what you do best.
太陽|雙子.watch: Talking more than doing, or agreeing to too much at once, is where you tend to get stuck. Check your calendar before saying yes, and say early on when you can't do something.

太陽|巨蟹.title: Keeping the people you care about close to your heart
太陽|巨蟹.plain: With the Sun in Cancer, your strength comes from caring and belonging. If you have a place you can safely return to and a few people you're truly close to, you can get through a lot. You're sensitive to atmosphere and often sense what others haven't said. That thoughtfulness is precious, but you can end up carrying other people's troubles as your own. Before looking after others, try asking yourself: am I tired today?
太陽|巨蟹.love: When you love someone, you put real care into it and want to look after them well. What you need is to feel cared about and remembered. When hurt, you may retreat into your shell first. Try saying what's bothering you instead of waiting for the other person to guess.
太陽|巨蟹.work: Roles that call for empathy and care suit you, such as customer service, HR, education, or mentoring newcomers. You do your best in a team you trust. When you move into a new environment, give yourself extra time to settle in.
太陽|巨蟹.watch: Keeping feelings inside too long is where you often get stuck: you say you're fine while turning things over and over inside. Telling someone you trust will help you work through it much faster than doing it alone.

太陽|獅子.title: Lighting up the people around you with warmth
太陽|獅子.plain: You naturally carry a bit of stage presence. People with the Sun in Leo like to do things beautifully and want their effort to be seen. When you feel appreciated, you become more generous and more willing to look after those around you. Your warmth is contagious and often gets a whole group moving. But when the applause fades, you may doubt yourself. Practice applauding yourself first, so your confidence doesn't depend entirely on others.
太陽|獅子.love: You're generous in love, enjoy creating surprises, and want your partner to be proud of you. Being neglected hurts you deeply. Rather than testing them, saying directly, "I need a little more praise from you," usually works better.
太陽|獅子.work: Visible positions suit you: leading a team, presenting to outsiders, brainstorming creative ideas. You can rally people. Remember to share the credit with those around you, and they'll be even more willing to follow.
太陽|獅子.watch: Pride is your small hurdle: you know you need help but feel awkward asking. Admitting you don't know something doesn't make you any less impressive.

太陽|處女.title: Someone who gets the details right
太陽|處女.plain: With the Sun in Virgo, your sense of achievement comes from getting things done well. You notice small things others miss, and you're happy to spend time organizing, fixing, and smoothing out a process. Being needed and useful makes you feel grounded. This care makes you very trustworthy, but when your standards climb too high, you can be very hard on yourself. Allow some things to be about 80% done, and save your energy for what truly matters.
太陽|處女.love: You express love in practical ways: handling chores for your partner and remembering small everyday needs. You may not be good at gushing words, and you may become picky without meaning to. Try phrasing your suggestions as care, and the other person will find them easier to hear.
太陽|處女.work: Detail-focused work like editing, research, administration, and technical support lets your strengths shine. You're dependable, but don't take on every little task. Learning to share the work is a skill too.
太陽|處女.watch: Wanting to polish things to perfection and then putting off handing them in is something to watch. Turn in a first version, then refine it slowly. That usually beats staying stuck.

太陽|天秤.title: Finding yourself in balance
太陽|天秤.plain: Harmony and fairness in relationships matter a great deal to you with the Sun in Libra. You're good at seeing both sides and are often the mediator among friends. Beauty matters too: a comfortable space and graceful interactions help you settle. But wanting everyone to be satisfied can make you forget what you really want. Before saying "anything's fine," try asking yourself: what about me?
太陽|天秤.love: You like relationships with give and take, and you value courtesy and an easy understanding. You dislike arguing and tend to swallow your dissatisfaction. In fact, saying your feelings honestly tends to make the relationship more balanced.
太陽|天秤.work: Work that calls for good judgment, like coordination, negotiation, design, and public relations, suits you. You're good at keeping collaboration smooth. When a decision has to be made, give yourself a deadline instead of putting it off.
太陽|天秤.watch: Not choosing at all for fear of choosing wrong is your common hesitation. Write the options on paper and pick one to try first. If it's the wrong path, you can still turn back and adjust.

太陽|天蠍.title: Deeply committed focus
太陽|天蠍.plain: Wanting to see everything through to the end is your nature. With the Sun in Scorpio, you don't care for surface things and always want to know the real reason underneath. For the people and causes you commit to, you give yourself fully and can handle a lot of pressure. Your intuition is sharp, and you often see the undercurrents in a room at a glance. But trust comes slowly, and once hurt you don't easily let go. Let yourself loosen up a little around safe people. You don't have to guard everything alone.
太陽|天蠍.love: You love deeply and want wholehearted commitment, nothing half-done. Loyalty matters a lot to you, and uncertainty can lead you to test people. Rather than guessing, just ask, and give each other a chance to be clear.
太陽|天蠍.work: The more complicated the situation, the more your ability shows. Investigation, analysis, crisis handling, and consulting all suit you. You can endure a lot, so remember to set work down regularly and catch your breath.
太陽|天蠍.watch: Taking things too heavily, or hiding your feelings and brooding, are the two things to watch. Try writing your worries down. You'll often find they're not as frightening as they seemed.

太陽|射手.title: An adventurous spirit that heads for far places
太陽|射手.plain: With the Sun in Sagittarius, your energy comes from the moment your view widens. Traveling, learning something new, and talking with people from different backgrounds all make the world feel big. You're optimistic and straightforward, and you believe there's always a way through. That optimism often carries those around you forward. But you hate being tied down, and plans can change in a moment. Set a small goal for the direction you want to go, so your freedom has somewhere to land.
太陽|射手.love: You need a partner to explore with, not someone who fences you in. You speak bluntly and sometimes sting the other person without meaning to. When you each keep some space in the relationship, you'll be more willing to stay.
太陽|射手.work: Education, publishing, travel, international work, and fields that demand constant learning suit you. You're good at seeing the big picture. Leave the details to people who are good at them, or make yourself a checklist.
太陽|射手.watch: Saying yes too fast and promising too much is a common sticking point for you. Before you speak, think: can I really do this? If you're not sure, state it more conservatively.

太陽|摩羯.title: Someone who climbs step by step
太陽|摩羯.plain: The words "I did it" give you the most confidence. With the Sun in Capricorn, you value responsibility, are willing to endure hardship for long-term goals, and can put up with the dullness along the way. Others may find you a bit serious, but you simply like to think things through before acting. Your achievements often come slowly, but they're solid. Still, you're so used to carrying things that you can forget to rest. Schedule time for play so your effort has room to breathe.
太陽|摩羯.love: In love you warm up slowly and cautiously, but once you've decided, you're very dependable. You show love by taking on responsibility and rarely say sweet things. Now and then, set reason aside and say "I care about you a lot." It will mean a great deal to them.
太陽|摩羯.work: Work that involves planning, management, and long-term building suits you. You have endurance and can carry responsibility, so management or a professional track fits well. Remember to let your supervisor see your contributions too.
太陽|摩羯.watch: Pushing yourself too hard and feeling you can't stop until you're good enough is something to be careful about. Beyond the results, also note down each small step of progress.

太陽|水瓶.title: It's okay to be different from everyone else
太陽|水瓶.plain: With your Sun in Aquarius, it matters to you that your thinking is free. You often look at things from different angles, and when you meet a rule you first ask "why does it have to be this way?" You value friends, groups, and ideas, and you're willing to put effort into what you care about. This independence gives you a clear sense of self, though it can sometimes make others feel a little distance. You can let close people know that your calm doesn't mean you don't care. You just like to think things through first.
太陽|水瓶.love: You need to be friends first, then lovers. You value your personal space and don't like being held too tightly. Find someone who respects your independence and also likes to talk about ideas with you, and the relationship will feel comfortable.
太陽|水瓶.work: You fit fields like technology, innovation, community, and public-interest work, where new ideas are needed. You're good at coming up with approaches others haven't thought of. When you push them forward, remember to explain more so your team can keep up.
太陽|水瓶.watch: Holding too firmly to your own reasoning and not hearing what's said on the feelings side is where you tend to get stuck. Listen to the other person fully first, then share your view.

太陽|雙魚.title: Understanding the world through feeling
太陽|雙魚.plain: Music, a story, a single image can move you in an instant. With your Sun in Pisces, you pick up on other people's emotions easily, your imagination is rich, and you often have plenty of inspiration. You're soft-hearted, and when you see someone struggling you want to help. This gentleness is your gift, but when your boundaries blur, it's easy to drain yourself. You can set aside some quiet time for yourself, put down other people's emotions, and then come back to listen to your own true voice.
太陽|雙魚.love: You love romantically and are willing to give a lot to your partner. You can easily think too well of them, and you soften easily. Let yourself see what they actually do, not just who you hope they are.
太陽|雙魚.work: You fit work in art, creation, helping, and companionship, or anywhere that needs imagination. You're sensitive to your surroundings, so a team with a friendly atmosphere will help you do your best.
太陽|雙魚.watch: Wanting to hide as soon as things get hard is a habit to watch. Try breaking a big problem into a few small steps and handling just one at a time.

月亮|牡羊.title: Feelings come fast and go fast
月亮|牡羊.plain: With your Moon in Aries, your emotions are direct. Happy or angry, it shows on your face. When you're uncomfortable, you need to do something right away, like going out for a walk or moving your body, before you feel better. You don't tend to brood, which is a strength, and after an argument you make up quickly. But when emotions rise, your words can get ahead of your thoughts. When the heat flares up, you can step away for a few minutes first, then come back to talk.
月亮|牡羊.love: You need someone who can hold your direct emotions and won't back away because you're briefly worked up. You also want your partner to take the initiative, and too much coolness can leave you feeling insecure. Saying what you need works better than expressing it through temper.
月亮|牡羊.work: You have more energy in an environment with challenge and a sense of progress. Being stuck at work too long makes you irritable. Try cutting big goals into small pieces you can finish quickly, so you keep feeling you're moving forward.
月亮|牡羊.watch: Replying on impulse and regretting it afterward is a common pattern for you. When your feelings are running high, don't hit send yet. Wait ten minutes and read it again.

月亮|金牛.title: A steady daily life relaxes you most
月亮|金牛.plain: A steady rhythm is what you need most inside. With your Moon in Taurus, a familiar place, a regular routine, or a good meal can settle you quickly. Your emotions don't swing much, and you tend to digest things slowly. This steadiness makes the people around you feel they can rely on you. But when change comes too suddenly, you may find it harder to adapt than others do. You can keep a few fixed small habits for yourself, so there's an anchor that stays put even amid change.
月亮|金牛.love: In love, you want something solid and lasting, and hot-and-cold behavior unsettles you. Hugs, company, and eating together are love to you. You're also sentimental, and letting go of a relationship takes you longer.
月亮|金牛.work: You do your best in a stable environment with a clear pace. Frequent changes of direction wear you out. You can ask your manager to confirm priorities so you know what to do first.
月亮|金牛.watch: Not saying when you're uncomfortable, pushing through until one day you suddenly blow up, is something to watch for. Say small dissatisfactions early, in a calm tone.

月亮|雙子.title: Saying it out loud makes you feel better
月亮|雙子.plain: With your Moon in Gemini, you process emotions by talking them out and thinking them through. Chatting with someone, writing it down, or looking something up can all put you more at ease. Your moods shift quickly and may change several times in a day. You need novelty, and days that are too monotonous make you feel stifled. But when your mind won't stop, you can overthink and sleep badly. Before bed, you can write your thoughts on paper and let your mind clock out first.
月亮|雙子.love: You need a partner you can talk with, and messages going back and forth matter to you. If the other person says little, you may feel left out. You can say directly that you'd like more interaction, rather than guessing.
月亮|雙子.work: You have more energy in an environment where information moves fast and you can exchange ideas with people. Handling several things at once isn't hard for you, but remember to keep a stretch of uninterrupted time for what truly matters.
月亮|雙子.watch: Pushing down feelings with logic, saying you're fine while actually caring a lot inside, is something you often do. Sometimes it's enough to admit, "I'm a little sad."

月亮|巨蟹.title: Home is your most important place to recharge
月亮|巨蟹.plain: A home where you can safely drop your guard, or a few people who truly understand you, is your greatest security. With your Moon in Cancer, your emotions are delicate and you need a sense of belonging. You're good at caring for people and often remember their preferences and moods. But you're also easily affected by the atmosphere, and one look from someone may keep you thinking for a long time. You can practice telling apart which feelings are your own and which you've simply picked up.
月亮|巨蟹.love: When you fall for someone, you're deeply committed. You want to look after them and build a little world together. You need to be cherished, and to be sure you're kept in their heart. When you feel unsure, asking directly is better than silently watching.
月亮|巨蟹.work: You feel most at ease in a team with a human touch. Cold environments that only look at numbers wear you out. You can find a few coworkers you can speak honestly with, to give yourself some support.
月亮|巨蟹.watch: Being sentimental and holding on to hurt for a long time is something to watch. You can sort through the past, but you don't need to keep turning back to it. Give yourself room to move forward.

月亮|獅子.title: Being seen gives you strength
月亮|獅子.plain: With your Moon in Leo, your mood is closely tied to feeling valued. Being praised, thanked, or treated as special makes you light up. You're generous, like making the people around you happy, and enjoy a bit of liveliness. But when you're overlooked, you may cover the hurt with pride. You can practice saying "I need you to notice me" directly. It isn't embarrassing, and it lets others know how to love you.
月亮|獅子.love: You need a partner who appreciates you and expresses affection, and romantic small gestures work well for you. You're also loyal and give a lot of warmth, so check that the other person is responding too.
月亮|獅子.work: You're most motivated where you can be creative and recognized. Working quietly with no one noticing discourages you. You can share your results on your own initiative so your effort gets seen.
月亮|獅子.watch: Taking others' coolness as rejection is where you tend to get stuck. When someone doesn't respond, it doesn't mean they don't care. Ask first before drawing a conclusion.

月亮|處女.title: Feeling at ease once life is in order
月亮|處女.plain: When you tidy your room and list your to-dos, you feel things are under control. With your Moon in Virgo, organizing is how you settle your emotions. You're careful and often quietly handle small matters for others. When you feel uneasy, you may keep checking and keep wondering what hasn't been done well. This care is valuable, but being too strict with yourself is tiring. You can tell yourself: what I did today is enough, and the rest can wait until tomorrow.
月亮|處女.love: You express love through practical care, like reminding your partner to eat or helping with small chores. You may not be one for sweet talk, and you easily notice your partner's small flaws. Remember to say more appreciation and less correction.
月亮|處女.work: You feel most at ease where processes are clear and roles are well defined. Chaos makes you tense. You can first make yourself a task list, then work through it one item at a time.
月亮|處女.watch: Constantly picking at yourself and feeling nothing is ever good enough is a common drain for you. Each day, note one thing you did well, and practice seeing yourself.

月亮|天秤.title: Harmonious relationships put you at ease
月亮|天秤.plain: With your Moon in Libra, your emotions are strongly shaped by your relationships. When the people around you get along, you feel settled, and when conflict appears you badly want to smooth it over. You read people well and value courtesy and beauty, and a pleasant, attractive space helps you relax. But when you want peace too much, you may swallow your own dissatisfaction. You can practice voicing differing opinions gently. Being agreeable doesn't mean having no voice.
月亮|天秤.love: You need a relationship of give and take with mutual respect. You dread arguments and often give way first. In fact, expressing your needs in a fitting way lets the other person know how to treat you well, and the relationship will last longer.
月亮|天秤.work: You're most at ease on a team that's harmonious and cooperative. Friction between people can pull your focus, so find a way that suits you to keep work matters and feelings separate.
月亮|天秤.watch: Making yourself small to avoid conflict is something to watch. Before you say yes, ask: do I really want this, or am I just too shy to say no?

月亮|天蠍.title: Deep, devoted feelings
月亮|天蠍.plain: You feel things deeply, but you don't show it easily. With the Moon in Scorpio, you open your heart to only a few people you truly trust, and once you do, you give yourself fully. Your intuition is strong, and you often sense what others leave unsaid. When you're hurt, though, you may hold your feelings in tightly or replay them again and again. Find a safe outlet, like journaling or talking with someone you trust, so the weight can slowly ease.
月亮|天蠍.love: You want deep, sincere connection and have little interest in surface-level relationships. Loyalty matters a lot to you, and insecurity can make you want to keep track of your partner. Saying your worries out loud brings you closer than quietly watching.
月亮|天蠍.work: You suit work that lets you focus deeply without interruption. In places where trust is low, you'll be guarded. Watch for a while first, then decide whom to open up to.
月亮|天蠍.watch: Remembering hurts and refusing to let go can make your path heavy. Letting go doesn't mean forgiving the other person. It means you no longer have to carry it all the time.

月亮|射手.title: Freedom lifts your mood
月亮|射手.plain: A short trip, a new book, or an interesting conversation can recharge you. With the Moon in Sagittarius, you need space and freshness to stay in good spirits. You're naturally optimistic and want to look on the bright side even when something sad happens. Sometimes, though, you skip past feelings too fast and the problem never gets dealt with. Before you say "it's fine," pause and check whether it really is.
月亮|射手.love: You need a partner who doesn't hold you too tightly, someone to explore and grow with. You speak plainly and can hurt people without meaning to. A little more patience in listening will bring you closer.
月亮|射手.work: You're happiest where there's room to learn and you're not tied down by small tasks. Repetitive work makes you feel stifled, so set yourself a small goal of learning something new.
月亮|射手.watch: Escaping is a common way for you to handle discomfort. Before you leave, say the one thing on your mind, then decide whether to go.

月亮|摩羯.title: Strong enough to endure, and able to let go
月亮|摩羯.plain: With the Moon in Capricorn, you tend to tuck your feelings away and finish the task first. You can endure a lot and don't like showing weakness in front of others. Having a plan, progress, and a clear next step puts you at ease. This strength makes people lean on you, but you may rarely let yourself rest properly. Try admitting "I get tired too." Letting someone take care of you now and then won't make you any less capable.
月亮|摩羯.love: In love, you need time to be sure someone can be trusted, so you start slowly. You often show you care through responsibility while saying little. Sometimes a single sentence is enough to let them know you care.
月亮|摩羯.work: You feel most secure where goals are clear and there's a path for advancement. You can carry a lot, but don't swallow all the pressure yourself. Telling your manager about your workload is a responsible thing to do.
月亮|摩羯.watch: Not letting yourself rest, and feeling that stopping means falling behind, is something to watch. Putting rest on your schedule is also a task worth completing.

月亮|水瓶.title: A need for a little space of your own
月亮|水瓶.plain: When emotions come up, you tend to step back and think first. With the Moon in Aquarius, you handle feelings in a more rational way. You need time alone and room to be yourself. Friends and like-minded groups matter a great deal to you. Sometimes, though, you set feelings aside, and others may see you as calm, even a bit distant. Now and then, try not to rush to figure things out. Just feel. That is also a way of knowing yourself.
月亮|水瓶.love: You need a relationship like a close friendship, with mutual respect and space for each of you. Too much clinginess or emotional demand makes you want to pull back. Saying you need time alone doesn't mean you don't love the other person.
月亮|水瓶.work: You're most comfortable where there's a lot of freedom and room for new ideas. Being tightly regulated annoys you, so try to arrange for yourself how you do the work, beyond the results.
月亮|水瓶.watch: Using analysis in place of feeling and keeping your real emotions out is your blind spot. Now and then ask yourself: setting the reasons aside, how do I feel right now?

月亮|雙魚.title: Soft-hearted, sensitive feelings
月亮|雙魚.plain: With the Moon in Pisces, you easily pick up other people's emotions, sometimes unable to tell whether they're yours or theirs. You recover with quiet time, music, or a place where you can zone out. You're compassionate and often want to help everyone. But when your boundaries get too blurry, you grow very tired. Practice checking whether you have the energy today before helping others. It's okay to say "I can't right now."
月亮|雙魚.love: You're gentle in love and easily sacrifice for the other person. You tend to fill in with imagination what they haven't said. Look more at what they actually do, and you can avoid some needless hurt.
月亮|雙魚.work: You do your best in a gentle atmosphere with room to create. High-pressure, highly competitive places drain you, so find a quiet corner of your own to recharge.
月亮|雙魚.watch: Absorbing everything into your heart until you're so tired you want to run away is a cycle to watch for. Set aside a stretch of time each day when you don't touch your messages.

水星|牡羊.title: A direct mind that says what it thinks
水星|牡羊.plain: With Mercury in Aries, your mind moves fast and ideas often flash up in an instant. You speak directly and like to get straight to the point. In discussions you're often the first to speak, which helps in situations that call for quick reactions. But when you talk too fast, details may not be fully thought through, and others may feel interrupted. Take a breath before speaking and put your main points in order. You'll be more persuasive.
水星|牡羊.love: You like things said clearly and dislike guessing games. In an argument you may say harsh words first and then feel it wasn't necessary. Try changing "you always" to "I feel," and the other person will find it easier to hear.
水星|牡羊.work: You suit work that needs quick decisions, brainstorming, and racing the clock. You have plenty of ideas, so remember to bring in a detail-minded person to fill in the specifics and help your ideas land.
水星|牡羊.watch: Responding before you've heard the whole thing is a small snag in your communication. In meetings, try repeating the other person's words first, then give your view.

水星|金牛.title: Speaks only once it's thought through
水星|金牛.plain: Your thinking isn't fast, but it's solid. That's Mercury in Taurus. You like to think things through step by step, and once you form a view, you're not easily swayed. You speak steadily, which makes people feel they can trust you, and you're good at using concrete examples to make abstract things easy to grasp. But when you hold too firmly to your own ideas, you may miss good advice from others. Practice treating "let me think about it" as openness rather than refusal.
水星|金牛.love: You speak gently and don't like arguments that get too heated. You need time to take in what the other person says and shouldn't be pushed to answer right away. You can say, "Give me a day, and I'll get back to you once I've thought it through."
水星|金牛.work: Work that takes patience and hands-on practice suits you best, such as budget management, quality control, and handcrafts. Your judgment is steady. When a new approach comes along, try one small step before deciding.
水星|金牛.watch: Pushing back at once when you hear a different opinion can turn into stubbornness. Try saying "That makes sense, let me think" first, then digest it slowly.

水星|雙子.title: A quick-minded collector of information
水星|雙子.plain: With Mercury in Gemini, you learn quickly and are good at explaining complicated things simply. You're curious about all kinds of information, and in conversation you can jump from topic to topic, always with something new to say. You react nimbly, and a single remark from you often lightens the mood. But with so many ideas, you may grab a bit here and a bit there and never finish. Give each thought a place to go: write it down, put it in order, then pick one to do first.
水星|雙子.love: You like having endless things to say to your partner, whether by text, voice messages, or memes. If they reply slowly, you may start imagining things. Don't fill in the blanks yourself. Just ask.
水星|雙子.work: You suit work that involves communication, such as writing, media, marketing, sales, and translation. You multitask well, but watch out for distraction. Use time blocks to protect the things that need focus.
水星|雙子.watch: Talking too much and listening too little is something to watch. In conversation, try asking one more question so the other person gets a chance to speak.

水星|巨蟹.title: Remembers everything through feeling
水星|巨蟹.plain: What you remember is often not just the event itself but also the atmosphere and mood at the time. With Mercury in Cancer, your thinking is tied to your emotions. You speak gently, take good care of others' feelings, and are good at listening, so people are glad to confide in you. But when you're in a bad mood, your judgment is easily affected too. Before making an important decision, wait until your feelings settle a little, and look at it again the next day.
水星|巨蟹.love: You're good at caring for people with thoughtful words, and you pay close attention to someone's tone. One cold reply can stay on your mind for a long time. When you're unsure, ask what the other person meant instead of guessing from a feeling.
水星|巨蟹.work: Work that calls for empathy and listening, such as education, writing, and client relations, comes easily to you. You have a good memory, and you can turn your experience into notes that become a resource for others.
水星|巨蟹.watch: Taking other people's words to heart and hearing them as criticism is where you often get stuck. First sort it out: is the person talking about the matter, or about you?

水星|獅子.title: Words that catch on
水星|獅子.plain: With Mercury in Leo, you speak with confidence and vivid pictures, and you easily draw people's attention. You like sharing ideas and tell stories well, and you speak with more energy when you feel truly heard. Your way of expressing yourself is warm and often lifts people up. But when you're questioned, you may feel your pride is on the line. Try treating a different opinion as a chance to round out your idea, not as a rejection of you.
水星|獅子.love: You show love with warm, generous words and like to let the other person know how you feel. You also need a response to what you share. If your partner doesn't say much, don't assume you're being neglected; it may just be their habit.
水星|獅子.work: Well suited to work that involves expression, such as presentations, teaching, creative work, performing, and branding. Your ideas are persuasive, and adding data or detail makes them even more convincing.
水星|獅子.watch: When you want to win, a discussion can easily turn into a fight over face. Start by finding one point you both agree on, then build from there.

水星|處女.title: Clear, orderly analysis
水星|處女.plain: Your mind works like a careful sorting machine. With Mercury in Virgo, you're good at analyzing, finding problems, and putting messy information in order. You speak clearly and practically, like to stick to the facts, and often spot the typo or gap others missed. This attention to detail is valuable, but when you overthink, it's easy to get stuck on small things. You can ask yourself: does this detail really matter that much to the whole thing?
水星|處女.love: You're good at caring about the details of your partner's life and giving practical advice. But sometimes what they need isn't a solution, it's to be heard. You can ask first: "Do you want my opinion, or just want me to listen?"
水星|處女.work: Well suited to work that needs precision, such as editing, research, data, administration, and technical roles. You catch mistakes well. When giving feedback, mention what was done well first, then what could change, and it will be easier to accept.
水星|處女.watch: Constantly finding fault, including with yourself, keeps things standing still. Finish first, perfect later, so things have a chance to move forward.

水星|天秤.title: A communicator who considers both sides
水星|天秤.plain: With Mercury in Libra, you speak politely and take care of everyone's feelings in the room. You tend to look at things from different angles, and in discussions you can often offer a way of putting things that everyone accepts. You value fairness and are good at coordinating and negotiating. But when you see too much of the whole picture, you can think for a long time without deciding. Set yourself a deadline, and when it arrives, pick the option you can best accept and adjust as you go.
水星|天秤.love: You say pleasant, fitting things and care about the mood of a conversation. You dislike head-on conflict and can end up hiding what you really think. Try saying what you want gently but clearly, and your partner will understand you better.
水星|天秤.work: Well suited to work that balances viewpoints, such as coordination, negotiation, PR, HR, and design. You're good at bringing opinions together; remember to state your own judgment clearly too.
水星|天秤.watch: Fearing you'll offend someone, you speak vaguely, and the other person ends up not understanding what you want. State the main point first, then add the considerate words.

水星|天蠍.title: Seeing through the surface
水星|天蠍.plain: A surface explanation rarely satisfies you; you want to know the real reason. With Mercury in Scorpio, you think deeply and like to get to the root. You observe sharply and often hear what people leave unsaid. You don't talk much, but when you speak, your words carry weight. But when you think too deeply, you can also guess the worst. Try raising your suspicion as a question instead of reaching a conclusion alone in your head.
水星|天蠍.love: You care about sincere conversation and dislike being brushed off. You notice shifts in your partner's mood, but you can also read too much into one small clue. If you have a doubt, ask directly and give them a chance to explain.
水星|天蠍.work: Well suited to work that needs depth, such as research, investigation, analysis, auditing, and strategic planning. You're good at finding the core of a problem; when you state a conclusion, remember to show others how you got there.
水星|天蠍.watch: Speaking too sharply and bottling things up are both worth watching. Try using a calm tone and explain your thoughts slowly.

水星|射手.title: Thinks far, speaks plainly
水星|射手.plain: With Mercury in Sagittarius, you like thinking about big questions and are interested in philosophy, culture, travel, and different viewpoints. You speak frankly, often hitting the nail on the head, and you use humor to put people at ease. You tend to grasp the big direction first and pay little attention to details, which gives you real vision, though you sometimes miss an important small point. After proposing a big plan, find someone to help write out the steps.
水星|射手.love: You like talking with your partner about dreams, the future, and life. You speak candidly, and sometimes being too blunt hurts them. Before telling the truth, think about how much they can take in right now.
水星|射手.work: Well suited to work in education, publishing, travel, cross-cultural settings, and anything needing big-picture thinking. Your ideas are inspiring; adding a checklist when you carry them out will make the result more complete.
水星|射手.watch: Promising too much, too fast, is a common slip for you. Confirm the details before you speak, and write down what you agree to, however small.

水星|摩羯.title: Practical, orderly thinking
水星|摩羯.plain: You think through the purpose and steps first, then act. That's you with Mercury in Capricorn. You speak carefully and don't state a position lightly, but what you say has usually been considered. You're good at planning, organizing, and breaking big goals into workable plans, which makes you trusted. But when you focus too much on results, you may discount new ideas at first. Leave a little room so that ideas that seem impractical get heard out.
水星|摩羯.love: You speak in a reserved way and aren't one for sweet talk, but your promises carry weight. Your partner may need more spoken expression, and an occasional "thank you" goes a long way.
水星|摩羯.work: Well suited to work needing logic and follow-through, such as management, planning, administration, engineering, and projects. You're steady; remember to share your own view in reports, not just hand in numbers.
水星|摩羯.watch: Thinking of the worst case first and then not wanting to try is a pessimism to watch for. List the risks, then list how you could handle them, and you'll feel more settled.

水星|水瓶.title: The out-of-the-box idea person
水星|水瓶.plain: With Mercury in Aquarius, your thinking often differs from others', and you like looking at problems from a new angle. You're interested in technology, society, and the future, and open to different views. You speak objectively and value reason over emotion in discussions, which often brings you new solutions. But when you hold too firmly to your own logic, others may feel you aren't listening. When explaining an idea, add a line about why you think so.
水星|水瓶.love: You enjoy intellectual exchange with your partner; talking about ideas is more fun to you than talking about trivia. Sometimes you're so rational that they feel you don't understand their feelings. Acknowledge the emotion first, then talk about solutions.
水星|水瓶.work: Well suited to work needing fresh thinking, such as technology, research, innovation, and community building. You offer different solutions; when pushing them forward, remember the pace your team can accept.
水星|水瓶.watch: Arguing to the end to prove you're right often leaves things stuck. Sometimes letting go of winning and losing gets things moving faster and more smoothly.

水星|雙魚.title: Thinking through imagination
水星|雙魚.plain: Your thinking is full of images, and you often understand things through intuition and feeling.
