海王星|水瓶.love: You need a partner who is both friend and comrade, someone to talk ideals with and join causes you care about. In love, a meeting of minds matters more than anything.
海王星|水瓶.work: Well suited to technology, community, public-interest, and innovation work. You can gather people under a shared ideal to make change together, and you're good at running online communities.
海王星|水瓶.watch: Your mind often lives in distant visions, so your own life can feel a bit adrift. Remember to look after your daily routine, your rhythms, and the people close to you.

海王星|雙魚.title: A heart rich in feeling
海王星|雙魚.plain: Neptune returning to Pisces is like coming home, and people born in those dozen or so years share a similar delicate temperament. This generation feels emotions, art, and other people's pain deeply, and often has a rich imagination. In you, it may be strong empathy, so that you hurt when others are sad, or finding a place for your feelings in music, images, and creative work. Your gentleness is something this world needs.
海王星|雙魚.love: In love you are deeply romantic and accepting, willing to give a lot for the people you love, sometimes to the point of forgetting yourself. Remember to protect yourself, so you don't slowly disappear inside a relationship.
海王星|雙魚.work: Suited to art, creative work, helping work, and other jobs that call for sensitivity. You can turn feelings into work that makes people feel understood and accompanied, which is a rare gift.
海王星|雙魚.watch: When your boundaries get too blurry, it's easy to be pulled along by other people's business while your own gets put aside. Learning to say "no" gently is also a form of kindness.

冥王星|牡羊.title: The courage to start over
冥王星|牡羊.plain: Pluto moves slowly, staying in one sign for anywhere from a dozen to over twenty years, so this is the shared backdrop of a whole generation. With Pluto in Aries, this generation carries a strong drive to begin things and believes its own actions can bring about a new situation. For you personally, it may show up as powerful willpower: once you decide to do something, you can start from zero and throw yourself into it. Your strength comes from daring to start again.
冥王星|牡羊.love: In love you are direct and passionate, and you like relationships that are real and straightforward. Strong feeling is part of your charm; remember to slow down a little and respect the other person's pace.
冥王星|牡羊.work: Suited to pioneering, leadership, and work that means building something from nothing. You have the boldness to push through big changes and make a fine trailblazer; the newer the situation, the better you do.
冥王星|牡羊.watch: When your will is too strong, you may try to push everything through with force and forget other people's views. Learn to wait and negotiate, and your strength will be put to better use.

冥王星|金牛.title: Rebuilding the foundation bit by bit
冥王星|金牛.plain: Pluto stays in a sign for many years, so people born in the same period share this deep trait. With Pluto in Taurus, this generation has a deep feel for resources, values, and security, and also rethinks what is truly worth having. In you, it may appear as great endurance and resilience, the ability to build up slowly and hold steady. Once you decide to protect something, you'll protect it for a long time.
冥王星|金牛.love: In love you are loyal and care a lot about mutual security. You may sometimes hold on tightly for fear of losing the other person; learning to trust and relax will make the relationship feel freer.
冥王星|金牛.work: Suited to work that needs endurance, long-term effort, or managing resources. You can hold onto the core amid change and slowly build solid results, giving your team a dependable base.
冥王星|金牛.watch: Clinging too hard to what you own makes it hard to let go and hard to move forward. Now and then ask yourself: is this still right for who I am now?

冥王星|雙子.title: Words that carry the power to change
冥王星|雙子.plain: Pluto stays in a sign for a long time, so this trait is carried together by a whole generation. With Pluto in Gemini, this generation has a deep influence on knowledge, information, and communication, and believes ideas can change the world. In you, it may appear as penetrating thinking and expression that gets right to the point. Your curiosity about knowledge runs deep, and when you learn something you want to understand it thoroughly.
冥王星|雙子.love: In love you need deep conversation; small talk doesn't move you. You'll commit fully to someone who can talk with you from the heart and is willing to trade honest words.
冥王星|雙子.work: Suited to research, writing, education, media, and other work that needs deep thinking and expression. Your words carry weight, and a single sentence can often wake someone up and shape how they think.
冥王星|雙子.watch: Speaking too bluntly and sharply can sometimes hurt people without your noticing. Before saying something important, think about how the other person will hear it.

冥王星|巨蟹.title: Home is the source of your strength
冥王星|巨蟹.plain: Pluto stayed in Cancer for many years, so this is an emotional imprint shared by a whole generation. This generation feels deeply about family, roots, and belonging, and the very shape of home is being redefined in their hands. In you, it may show as a strong protectiveness toward family, or a deep emotional strength that carries you through life's ups and downs. For the people you care about, you will guard them with your whole heart.
冥王星|巨蟹.love: In love you are deeply affectionate and protective, keeping your partner close like family. Learn to let them look after you too, and your deep feeling will be more balanced and last longer.
冥王星|巨蟹.work: Suited to caregiving, family-related work, or work that builds a sense of belonging. You can bring a team together and have strong protective power; people think of you first when trouble comes.
冥王星|巨蟹.watch: Feelings from the past may stay inside you for a long time without your noticing. Give yourself time to sort through old feelings slowly, and your heart will feel lighter.

冥王星|獅子.title: Live out your own weight
冥王星|獅子.plain: People born during the dozen or so years Pluto was in Leo share a similar generational temperament; this isn't something only you have. This generation values self-expression and personal power, and believes everyone can live a brilliant life. In you, it may appear as strong presence and creativity: once you commit to something, you give it your all. Your passion is contagious and can lift others up.
冥王星|獅子.love: In love you are passionate and devoted, wanting to be deeply loved and willing to give fully. Sincere appreciation and affirmation from your partner make you feel most secure and loved.
冥王星|獅子.work: Suited to leadership, creative work, performing, and other roles that need personal charisma. You have a strong will and can lead a team to get things done, and people are glad to follow you.
冥王星|獅子.watch: Caring too much about your position and face can lead you into rivalry where neither side gives way. Bring your focus back to what you want to accomplish, and you'll have more strength.

冥王星|處女.title: Changing the world through details
冥王星|處女.plain: Pluto stays in a sign for a dozen or so years, so you share this placement with people your age. With Pluto in Virgo, this generation values work, method, and efficiency, and often wants to thoroughly improve old ways of doing things. In you, it may appear as strong analytical and executive ability; when you see a problem, you want to solve it at the root. Your changes are practical, built from small things done well that slowly add up to a big difference.
冥王星|處女.love: In love you are practical, showing love through care and problem-solving. Don't be too strict with each other; accept imperfections, and the relationship will be lighter and more at ease.
冥王星|處女.work: Suited to research, analysis, process improvement, and specialized technical work. You can find the step where a whole process gets stuck and fix it at the root, so everyone works more smoothly.
冥王星|處女.watch: Expecting too much of yourself and others lets stress build up. Let yourself off the hook now and then; doing seventy or eighty percent is fine, and the rest can be filled in slowly.

冥王星|天秤.title: Seeing yourself in relationships
冥王星|天秤.plain: Pluto takes many years to pass through a sign, so people born in the same period share this background. With Pluto in Libra, this generation cares about relationships, fairness, and cooperation, and rethinks what partnership and human connection should look like. In you personally, it may be a deep investment in relationships; you often come to know yourself better through dealing with others. You believe in fairness and are willing to work for it.
冥王星|天秤.love: In love you are devoted and value equality. Good relationships help you grow a lot; remember to keep your own position and views while you give, and you don't always have to yield.
冥王星|天秤.work: Suited to collaboration, negotiation, design, and work that needs fair judgment. You can see the balance of power between people and find a way both sides accept, so partnerships last.
冥王星|天秤.watch: Caring too much about balance in relationships may leave you constantly adjusting and constantly yielding. Now and then ask yourself what you want before deciding how to accommodate.

冥王星|天蠍.title: A deep and resilient soul
冥王星|天蠍.plain: Pluto is most at home in Scorpio, and people born during the dozen or so years it stayed there share a similar depth. This generation is strongly curious about truth, psychology, and the depths of human nature, and isn't afraid to face difficult emotions. In you, it may appear as strong intuition and resilience; after a low point, you can always find the strength to stand up again. Your depth makes you very good at understanding others.
冥王星|天蠍.love: In love you are devoted, wanting a wholehearted connection. Trust matters a great deal to you and takes time to build, but once built, the bond is deep and lasting.
冥王星|天蠍.work: Suited to research, psychology, crisis handling, and work that needs insight. You aren't afraid of complicated situations; the harder it gets, the more your ability shows, and you often take charge at the critical moment.
冥王星|天蠍.watch: When your feelings run too strong, you may want to control everything and can't let go even of small things. Try relaxing a little, and you'll find that trust is also a kind of strength.

冥王星|射手.title: Committing deeply to what you believe
冥王星|射手.plain: Pluto stays in a sign for a long time, and the Sagittarius stretch is a shared background for many people of the same age. With Pluto in Sagittarius, this generation searches deeply for beliefs, truth, and understanding of the world, and is used to meeting the cultures of other countries. In you, it may appear as a strong longing to find life's meaning; once you believe in an idea, you commit fully. Your outlook is wide, and you dare to change outdated thinking.
冥王星|射手.love: In love, you need shared values. You're most drawn to someone who can explore the world with you and talk about life. Give each other room to grow, and the relationship gets deeper and steadier.
冥王星|射手.work: Well suited to education, international work, publishing, and jobs that involve spreading ideas. With your enthusiasm and persuasiveness, you help more people see new possibilities and get them to act together.
冥王星|射手.watch: If you trust your own reasoning too much, you may not hear other views and end up in heated arguments. Stay open, and your beliefs will mature.

冥王星|摩羯.title: Rebuilding solid structures
冥王星|摩羯.plain: Pluto moves slowly and stayed in Capricorn for more than a decade, so this is a trait shared by people of the same era. This generation grew up while old structures were being reworked, and thinks deeply about authority, institutions, and responsibility. In you, it may show up as strong ambition and endurance, and a willingness to spend a long time building your own career or life. You believe your own effort can lay a foundation that is deep and steady.
冥王星|摩羯.love: In love, you value commitment and long-term planning, and want to build a stable future with your partner. Remember to set seriousness aside now and then, to play and laugh together and enjoy easy time as a couple.
冥王星|摩羯.work: Well suited to management, running a business, and work that needs long-term planning. You're patient and ambitious and can handle pressure, so you can accomplish big things step by step and keep growing in scale.
冥王星|摩羯.watch: Caring too much about achievement may push you too hard, so that you forget to rest and sleep. Pause now and then and look at how far you've come.

冥王星|水瓶.title: Rewriting the rules together
冥王星|水瓶.plain: Pluto stays in Aquarius for many years, so people born during this time share similar generational traits. This generation is tuned in to technology, groups, and new forms of society, and believes we can rewrite the rules together. In you, it may show up as very independent thinking and a wish to do something for more people. You don't easily accept "that's just how it is," and want to find a fairer, newer way.
冥王星|水瓶.love: In love, you need equality and respect, and you value each other's independence. The best partner is someone who can pursue ideals alongside you and still give you room to be yourself.
冥王星|水瓶.work: Well suited to work in technology, community, innovation, and social issues. You can gather like-minded people, push for real change, and help good ideas reach more people.
冥王星|水瓶.watch: When you're set on changing the big picture, it's easy to neglect the people close to you. Now and then, set the ideals aside and listen to what those close to you have been thinking and needing lately.

冥王星|雙魚.title: A quiet strength inside gentleness
冥王星|雙魚.plain: Pluto stays in a sign for many years, so this trait is shared by your whole generation. With Pluto in Pisces, this generation is especially sensitive to the spirit, art, and other people's feelings, and often changes the world through imagination and empathy. In you, it may show up as deep sensitivity, sensing emotions others can't put into words. Your gentleness isn't weakness; it's a strength that can calm people.
冥王星|雙魚.love: In love, you're very accepting and give your partner a great deal of understanding and consideration. Remember to look after your own boundaries so love goes both ways: you give, and you're also well received.
冥王星|雙魚.work: Well suited to art, creative work, helping professions, and jobs that call for empathy. Through your work or actions you can touch many people, helping them feel understood, less alone, and willing to come closer again.
冥王星|雙魚.watch: Absorbing other people's emotions too easily can leave you exhausted without knowing why. Give yourself regular time alone to draw your energy back in.

ph.太陽|1: With the Sun in the 1st house, your presence is direct. When you walk into a room, people quickly sense your personality. You're used to stepping forward and deciding for yourself, and you're willing to lead. Where you can get stuck is caring too much how others see you; saying clearly what you want is stronger than rushing to prove yourself.
ph.太陽|2: A big part of your confidence comes from knowing "I can support my own life." People with the Sun in the 2nd house have a clear sense of money, possessions, and what they're worth. Linking income with ability is fine, but don't let the number in your account decide whether you're happy today. A sense of worth can also come from doing one thing well.
ph.太陽|3: With the Sun in the 3rd house, you shine by talking, writing, and exchanging ideas. You're very curious and like taking in lots of information at once, and siblings, classmates, and neighbors often play important roles in your life. Watch for switching topics too fast and scattering your thoughts; pick one or two things you truly want to go deeper into and build up slowly.
ph.太陽|4: For you, home is a source of energy. With the Sun in the 4th house, you care a lot about where you come from and your relationship with family, and you put effort into making your home a place that feels safe. Others may not see your light at first glance, because your focus is inward; give yourself a corner to relax in, and you'll be steadier outside too.
ph.太陽|5: People with the Sun in the 5th house naturally need fun and to be seen. Creating, performing, romance, raising children, or pursuing a hobby can all light you up. Where you can get stuck is needing applause so much that you deflate when no one responds; do things first for your own joy, and people who like you will naturally come closer.
ph.太陽|6: You find fulfillment in getting everyday life in order. With the Sun in the 6th house, you value efficiency, process, and detail, and at work you're the one who makes things land solidly. Be careful not to tie your whole worth to whether things are finished, getting anxious when your routine slips; schedule rest too, and once the rhythm is right, you work more smoothly.
ph.太陽|7: With the Sun in the 7th house, you often come to know yourself through one-on-one relationships: partners, collaborators, and close friends all act like mirrors. You know how to cooperate and value fairness. Watch for putting all your focus on the other person; keep your own opinions and space in the relationship, and the two of you will go further.
ph.太陽|8: People with the Sun in the 8th house aren't satisfied with surface things and want to understand what lies deep in people and behind relationships. You value trust, and may go through big changes around shared money and deep intimacy. Here you can get stuck on not wanting to show vulnerability; when you're willing to say what you truly care about, relationships become stronger.
ph.太陽|9: Your vitality comes from seeing a bigger world. With the Sun in the 9th house, traveling far, studying, and meeting different cultures or beliefs help you grow a great deal. You like exploring meaning and have potential as a teacher. Watch for talking only about ideals without grounding them; turn an idea into a small plan you can start right away.
ph.太陽|10: With the Sun in the 10th house, you care about what you accomplish in society, and you have the drive to be seen and recognized. Career and reputation matter a lot to you, and you're willing to work toward goals for the long haul. Where you can get stuck is treating your title as your whole self; outside work, keep a part of life that belongs only to you.
ph.太陽|11: With the Sun in the 11th house, you shine most in groups. Your circle of friends, communities, and like-minded partners are often the stage where you realize your ideals. You put effort into things that matter to everyone, and you have a vision for the future. Watch for shortchanging yourself to fit in; choosing the right circle matters more than being in many circles.
ph.太陽|12: Your light is quieter and often works behind the scenes. People with the Sun in the 12th house need time alone, and find their direction by getting still, journaling, meditating, or creating. Where you can get stuck is not daring to step forward; start by sharing in a small circle, and you'll find your sensitivity carries real weight.
ph.月亮|1: With the Moon in the 1st house, your emotions often show on your face, and others easily sense how you're feeling today. You're sensitive and empathetic, and give a warm first impression. Where you can get stuck is mood swings directly affecting your actions; first notice "what am I feeling right now," then decide whether to respond, and you'll be much calmer.
ph.月亮|2: Security is very practical for you: your heart settles when you have savings, steady income, and familiar things around you. With the Moon in the 2nd house, you may want to buy things to comfort yourself when you feel low. That's normal; just pause first and ask: do I need this thing, or the feeling of being cared for?
ph.月亮|3: With the Moon in the 3rd house, your feelings need to be spoken or written out to be processed. Chatting with siblings and old friends is often your best way to relieve stress. You learn quickly, and you're easily influenced by what people around you say. When there's too much information your mind gets cluttered; give yourself some time away from your phone, and your thoughts will be much clearer.
ph.月亮|4: Home is what you care about most. With the Moon in the 4th house, you have a deep connection to family, childhood, and where you live, and returning to familiar surroundings recharges you. You're good at caring for people, and you want to be cared for too. Here you can get stuck carrying past emotions with you; try to tell which belong to you now and which are old habits.
ph.月亮|5: With the Moon in the 5th house, joy feeds your emotions. Play, creating, romance and time with children all soften your heart. You put a lot into love and need your partner's response and praise. Watch for using romance to fill an empty place inside; cheer yourself up first, and love will feel lighter.
ph.月亮|6: Your mood is tied closely to your daily rhythm. With the Moon in the 6th house, a steady routine and smooth work keep you calm; when your schedule gets thrown off, you can grow irritable. You handle feelings by doing things, and you take good care of your coworkers. Remember that when you're tired, you're allowed to stop. You don't have to carry everything yourself.
ph.月亮|7: With the Moon in the 7th house, you feel most secure in relationships and truly need a partner to share your thoughts with. You're considerate and good at reading other people's moods, and you can easily treat their feelings as your responsibility. Watch for leaning too much on the other person for security; look after your own needs first, then tend the relationship together.
ph.月亮|8: Your emotions run deep and don't open easily, but once you trust someone, you give everything. With the Moon in the 8th house, intimate relationships and shared finances often stir your heart. You're very sensitive to other people's feelings and may hide your own unease. Finding someone you can safely tell the truth to is the first step toward feeling lighter.
ph.月亮|9: With the Moon in the 9th house, what settles you is having direction and meaning. Travel, reading and meeting different ideas open your heart. You may long for faraway places and find staying put stifling. That longing deserves to be taken seriously; even if you can't go far for now, you can start with a class or a book.
ph.月亮|10: Your emotions are closely tied to your achievements at work. With the Moon in the 10th house, you care how others see you, and you may work in caregiving or public service. Your mood lifts when work goes well and hurts more when you hit setbacks. Try separating "Am I doing well?" from "Am I worthy of love?"
ph.月亮|11: With the Moon in the 11th house, your friends are like family. You feel secure with a group of people you click with, and you're often the one quietly looking after everyone. You can get stuck caring too much whether everyone likes you; real friends will understand when you occasionally don't feel like going along.
ph.月亮|12: With the Moon in the 12th house, you have a rich inner world but aren't used to letting others see it. You need time alone to process your feelings, and sometimes you can't even say why you feel low. This isn't a problem; it's a sign of how strongly you feel. Give your emotions an outlet, like writing, drawing or walking, and your heart will slowly clear.
ph.水星|1: With Mercury in the 1st house, you come across as quick and articulate, with new ideas always in your head. You think as you talk and easily start conversations with strangers. Watch for speaking so fast that others can't keep up, or agreeing before you've thought it through; for important matters, pause for three seconds first.
ph.水星|2: Your mind is practical, and your ideas often connect to whether something can become income. With Mercury in the 2nd house, you're suited to earning through speaking, writing, analysis or negotiating prices. You compare options again and again before deciding. You can get stuck overthinking and not moving; once you have enough information, give yourself a deadline to decide.
ph.水星|3: Mercury in the 3rd house is a place where it feels right at home. You're curious, ask a lot of questions and learn quickly; writing, chatting and organizing information come easily, and you often have plenty to talk about with siblings or classmates. Watch for opening too many projects and finishing each only halfway; pick one topic and go deep, and your words will carry more weight.
ph.水星|4: Your thinking often circles back to home and the past. With Mercury in the 4th house, you may focus best at home, which suits working or studying there; the way your family talks also deeply shapes your thinking habits. You can get stuck keeping thoughts bottled up; talking about family matters openly is easier than guessing on your own.
ph.水星|5: With Mercury in the 5th house, you're a fun, creative speaker and a good storyteller. You suit writing, planning, teaching or anything that needs ideas, and in romance you value easy conversation. Watch for making things sound so good that details get skipped; for important promises, confirm them once in writing.
ph.水星|6: Your mind is good at planning daily life. With Mercury in the 6th house, you're skilled at organizing processes, making lists and catching details, and you're the reliable one at work. You can get stuck overthinking small things, unable to stop your mind even while resting; write tomorrow's tasks down before bed so your mind can take a break.
ph.水星|7: With Mercury in the 7th house, many of your ideas grow out of conversation with others. You suit negotiating, counseling and mediating, and you care whether a partner can communicate well. Watch for caring so much about the other person's opinion that you lose your own; write down your thoughts first, then listen to others, and you'll have a clearer direction.
ph.水星|8: Your thinking likes to dig deep and isn't satisfied with surface answers. With Mercury in the 8th house, you're good at research, investigation and seeing what others leave unsaid, and you're careful with shared finances. You can get stuck overthinking and becoming suspicious of people; if you have a question, ask it directly rather than running ten scenarios in your head.
ph.水星|9: With Mercury in the 9th house, your mind likes big questions: the meaning of life, how different cultures think, how the world works. You suit further study, writing, teaching or international work. Watch for reasoning so much that you forget the details; break big ideas into doable steps so you can actually move forward.
ph.水星|10: Your career often involves speaking and writing. With Mercury in the 10th house, you express yourself clearly at work, are good at planning and communication, and fit roles that explain things to the public.
